# Fixture provenance

- `uplink_encoded.bin` is 552 bytes of test data generated by FlightAware
  dump978's `encode_rs_char` at pinned commit
  `f40aa9a0d2d0a0067c0c628b44ba316f7049b8ce`. Six 72-byte data blocks contain
  the byte sequence 0 through 431, each block is encoded as RS(92,72) with
  GF(256), polynomial `0x187`, first root 120, and parity blocks are interleaved
  in transmission order. The expected corrected payload is independently
  generated from that sequence in the tests.
- Short and long downlink examples use the first `-` sample records from the
  same upstream `sample-data.txt.gz`; their parity was independently generated
  using upstream `encode_rs_char` with the UAT short/long profile. The long
  codeword is also modulated into a synthetic complex-IQ waveform in
  `src/rx.rs` to exercise sync, FSK decisions, arbitrary chunking, FEC and
  field extraction together.
